name: todocloud
//private: Nothing in this repository is published to a registry: `tdo` ships as the compiled executable (scripts/build-binary.mjs) through Homebrew and the GitHub release archives. `private` is what keeps it that way — an `npm publish` run here refuses outright rather than pushing the TypeScript sources and the tests to a registry — and the manifests point at `.ts` because the workspace runs its sources directly.
//files: assets is a runtime dependency, not a nicety. src/web/web.ts resolves ../../assets relative to the module and reads it when `tdo serve` starts, where Go had go:embed (MIGRATION.md, "the viewer's assets are a runtime dependency now"). Nothing packs this manifest any more — the executable is what ships, and scripts/build-binary.mjs embeds the same directory with `--asset` — so this list is the declaration of what has to travel with the module for `tdo serve` to work at all, and the reason assets is not treated as build output that can be left behind.
